text:
**The evidence does not establish whether the 2021 tree-cover loss was illegal.**

The analysis detected 81.3 hectares of loss, of which 68.1 hectares overlapped mapped pine plantations. No loss overlapped mapped native forest; the remaining 13.2 hectares lay outside mapped forest. A further 37.3 hectares of loss occurred in patches smaller than the tool’s 0.5-hectare event threshold.

These observations do not establish the cause of the loss or whether it was authorized. Determining legality would require checking applicable rules, permits and land-management records.
